description.value: Monashee Community Co-op is a member-owned, volunteer-supported natural grocery store in Lumby, BC, celebrating over a decade of community operation. It specializes in local, organic, non-GMO, and gluten-free products sourced as close to home as possible, with an emphasis on BC farms and producers. A touring cyclist resupplying in the North Okanagan/Monashee corridor would find a thoughtfully curated selection of whole foods, fresh produce, and pantry staples.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website clearly identifies the store as being at #3-1879 Vernon Street, Lumby BC — not Coldstream as the OSM community tag suggests — and confirms the phone number (778) 473-2230 and URL. The site describes a broad range of grocery staples including produce, meat, dairy, and baked goods, confirming the basic groceries amenity; no mention of bike parking, water refill, or cycling-specific amenities anywhere in the fetched content. A January 2025 blog post notes members voted to move to a larger space in 2025, so the address on the website may already be outdated.
concerns: OSM community tag says 'Coldstream' but the store is located in Lumby BC (~30 km away) — OSM geocoordinates should be verified.
OSM name is 'Monashee Community Coop' but the business consistently uses 'Monashee Community Co-op' (with hyphen) on its website.
January 2025 blog post reports members voted to relocate to a larger space in 2025; the address #3-1879 Vernon Street may be the former location — address should be verified before publishing.
OSM record had no phone or address; both were sourced from the website only.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: An active, well-established community grocery cooperative offering a broad local and organic food selection in Lumby — a useful resupply stop for cyclists touring the North Okanagan and Monashee corridor.
enrichment_extras.notes: Store carries bulk produce order options for members. The co-op is a member of the BC Co-op Association and is staffed largely by volunteers.

wow_evidence: member-owned, volunteer-supported natural grocery store in Lumby, BC, celebrating over a decade of community operation
